declared.l1_witness: The pilot was registered as a discriminating test of the working hypothesis that stateful proof-state interaction would be no better than blind whole-proof generation at equal model and equal wall-clock budget. The discordant eighteen of thirty versus zero of thirty outcome with one-sided exact p of three point eight times ten to the minus six is the kill: the prior working hypothesis is operator-falsified, and the Rung-1 prior conclusion that stateful does not beat blind is recategorized as a substrate artifact rather than evidence against stateful interaction.
declared.l2_witness: The canonical end-to-end task of producing a Mathlib proof was split into two parallel arms holding model identical and budget identical while varying only the interaction modality. The two arms were recomposed only at scoring time so pairwise discordance could be measured via the one-sided binomial. The decomposition is the move that made the contrast clean and the recomposition into a rare-pair statistic gave the kill on the working hypothesis.
declared.l3_witness: Anti-rigging check: both arms ran the same model at the same three hundred sixty second wall-clock budget on the same thirty-theorem leak-tight corpus, with the base-rate gate pre-registered at union zero point six zero to exclude floor and ceiling regimes. The blind arm median attempt time of seventy-three seconds far below the three hundred sixty second budget rules out a timeout artifact. The stateful arm caveat that workspace-write was enabled and usedConstants audit was not enforced is named explicitly in the result text so future readers cannot mistake the scoped magnitude claim for an unscoped one.

Both came back pooled-null. The discipline that survives is that cheap interventions cannot recover ensemble independence once exposure has occurred, which forces the architectural fix and forecloses one whole family of future proposals as scientifically settled rather than open.
declared.l2_witness: The obstruction to recovering independence after exposure is identified as anchoring at the activation level rather than at the reasoning level. The exposed forecasters probability lies on the line through the prior at slope zero point seven four five regardless of whether the receiver was instructed to be skeptical of that prior; instruction is a single-token cue against multi-step prior context and operates downstream of the anchor. The obstruction is therefore architectural, not pedagogical.
declared.l3_witness: Anti-monoculture check: the test ran across all six directional pairs of the three-agent trio. All six pairs slope between zero point six five and zero point eight six; the result is not driven by one pair. Pooled across pairs the receiver-shift Spearman with prior_gap is zero point nine one three, near-deterministic. A monoculture failure would have shown one pair behaving very differently; this one shows the failure is the architecture, not the agent mix.

goal: Show that direct skeptical-instruction framing fails to reduce herding on exposed forecasts and therefore that ensemble independence requires architectural sealing rather than a behavioral fix

declared.l1_witness: The pilot was set up to discriminate between two scheduling hypotheses for the proof mill: LLM yield-prediction picks goals to try first more reliably than FIFO, or it does not. All three agents produced Brier strictly worse than constant-zero-point-five with negative Spearman of forecast against realized closure. The discriminating test killed the LLM-yield-prediction-as-scheduler hypothesis cleanly; the FIFO null hypothesis survives by default.
declared.l2_witness: The obstruction is that subscription-class LLMs have learned from training data which proof states LOOK hard, but the apparatus mill specifically handles hard cases under policies the agents do not model. The agents world-model of what closes does not match the mills actual conditional closure distribution given probe class. The anti-correlation, not mere uninformativeness, indicates that the agents hardness signal is systematically wrong-signed for this mill rather than simply absent.
declared.l3_witness: Anti-satisficing check: the temptation is to substitute an LLM yield score for the cost of building a domain-specific scheduler heuristic. The test rejects that satisficing path empirically at three agent classes; the alternative (FIFO plus non-LLM heuristics on prior agent yield, proof depth, dependency-graph features) is identified by name as the path the apparatus must take rather than as an open future option. The yield-prediction shortcut is foreclosed; tool underuse would now be re-using the shortcut.

goal: Show that subscription-class reasoning LLMs perform worse than a constant-zero-point-five baseline at predicting Lean proof closure on a stratified probe corpus, so the self-scheduling proof-mill pattern is unavailable for this agent class
